trunk.text: Start at the ground and draw the two long sides of the trunk up to the crown, bending gently left.

crown.text: At the top of the trunk, outline the coconuts as overlapping shapes, and let the first line run on into the lowest frond.

lower-left-frond.text: Work outward along that low frond, adding its narrow leaflets close together, all aimed at the tip.

middle-left-frond.text: From the crown, sweep a broad frond to the left, then add its leaflets from the trunk outward.

upper-left-fronds.text: Draw the higher frond toward the upper left, then the shorter one rising behind it. Keep the two fans distinct.

upper-right-frond.text: Back to the crown: sweep the top frond out to the right and add its leaflets from the centre outward.

middle-right-frond.text: From the crown again, draw the wide frond reaching right. Let the last leaflets droop a little.

lower-right-frond.text: One final frond from the crown down to the right, with hanging leaflets to balance the left side.

ground.text: Shape a small patch of sand around the trunk, then a few grass tufts and two loose marks near the edges.

leaf-colour.text: Fill the crown with the two deep greens, then add the pale highlights across the fronds.

trunk-coconut-colour.text: Warm browns for the coconuts and the trunk, with the darker brown along the shaded side.

ground-colour.text: Light tan for the sand, and the muted brown for the grass and the scattered marks. That's your palm tree.
